lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the mid-lateral flank, organized into roughly four primary horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice pattern where the primary spots are positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with illuminated top edges and shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin features a non-uniform distribution of at least 12 high-luminance spots, with a higher density of smaller spots concentrated near the anterior margin and the base of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin exhibits irregular notches and the attachment of multiple elongated remoras, disrupting the smooth anatomical silhouette of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct transition from large, widely-spaced spots on the mid-body to extremely dense, fine-grained speckling on the cranial region anterior to the gill slits.
